scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && pip install -r optimizer/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n optimizer,server,client -c yellow,cyan,green "python optimizer/app.py" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test -- --watchAll=false && python -m pytest optimizer -q
